detail: re-planned: Re-plan requested by reviewer: Corrections

kind=design-and-schema; reason=re-planned: Corrections from the real url-shortener code, which you were not given: (1) Persistence is Spring Data JDBC, not JPA. Link is an immutable Java record in package link, annotated with @Table and @Column from org.springframework.data.relational.core.mapping, mapping fields id, shortCode to short_code, longUrl to long_url, clickCount to click_count, createdAt to created_at. There is no Hibernate, no ddl-auto, no entity lifecycle, no JPQL. (2) LinkRepository extends CrudRepository of Link and Long and already has findByShortCode and an atomic incrementClickCount via a Modifying Query annotation using plain SQL, not JPQL. Add a similarly atomic Modifying Query method deleteExpiredBefore(Instant cutoff) using plain SQL (e.g. DELETE FROM links WHERE expires_at is not null and expires_at less than the cutoff parameter); there is no separate clicks child table. (3) Schema is url-shortener/src/main/resources/schema.sql, applied every startup via spring.sql.init.mode set to always, using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, with no Flyway or Liquibase present and none should be added. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will NOT add a column to an already-created H2 file database. The migration must use ALTER TABLE links ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS expires_at TIMESTAMP and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_links_expires_at ON links(expires_at), both idempotent and safe to re-run on every startup, appended directly to schema.sql. (4) Existing configuration is one class AppProperties, ConfigurationProperties prefix app, with a nested RateLimit group; keep that convention and add a nested Link properties group under the same app prefix, such as app.link.default-ttl, app.link.cleanup-interval, app.link.cleanup-grace, instead of a new LinkProperties class or a new shortener.link prefix. (5) The redirect endpoint is RedirectController, the service is LinkService, and errors are already centralised in ApiExceptionHandler, a RestControllerAdvice, which maps InvalidUrlException, LinkNotFoundExcept
